feed.subtitle: Diagram-first design walkthroughs of automations, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure by Allan Niñal. Open to builds, collabs, and design reviews.

entry.title: A search rank reporter on AWS for a few dollars a month
entry.summary: Groups thousands of query rows into six themes, reports movement big enough to mean something, and names the pages responsible. AWS, about $1 a month. Part 1 of 7 in the Search rank reporter series.
